selection_basis.report_section: 3: A1 7 valid pairs only D passes; CA 4 pairs only D passes
selection_basis.rule: Select stage A1 or CA, original P terminal pass_=false and error=null, paired same-task/same-rep D terminal pass_=true. Preserve every selected original pair; no replacement or task retuning.
selection_basis.interpretation: 11 outcome-selected historical trajectory pairs, not11 independent physical tasks. Legacy P failure is selection metadata, not a fresh stochastic baseline or proof every new Agent will fail. New treatment comparisons must be run afresh on the identical frozen physical instance.

legacy_information.P: Current design, pass_, terminal service/stress/travel counts, continuous slack, base storage/peak voltages/cold-charge/stage counts, remaining actions. No diagnostic block.
legacy_information.D: Exactly P plus actual main background amplitude/phase, actual aux target amplitude/phase, energy_J, minimum_active_storage_V, event_windows from the same full transient. No private factors or PASS design.

fixed_mapping.other_fixed_parameters: Use each exact original_initial_full_design, not the newer funnel14-variable design schema. Initial energy is zero in the original consumer.

private_manifest: Contains hidden factors, full physical instance and historical PASS witnesses; do not place in learner-accessible working directories.

spec.acquisition: 128 points at 2048Hz, actual ADC and spectral confirmation
spec.main_beam: 10mm wide steel/PZT bimorph, .15mm substrate and .12mm layers,4.65g tip mass
spec.aux_beam: 6mm wide, .10mm substrate/.08mm PZT layers,.14g tip mass
spec.circuit: Diode rectifier; auxiliary voltage can enter RC envelope detector; comparator can gate MCU; otherwise MCU polls at100ms. Installed auxiliary beam and RC loads participate in coupled ODE.

spec.uncertainty: Effective beam lengths can differ from nominal dimensions by an unknown, stationary manufacturing/mounting factor; zero deviation is possible.

diagnosis.label: INFEASIBLE
diagnosis.reason: The declared storage node cannot be driven to the boot threshold by the available harvest, so the MCU can never start and nothing can ever be delivered. Measured ceiling: best max_storage ≈1.10 V at main=33mm/C=80µF. Main length is a sharp single resonance near 33mm (26→0.49 V, 33→1.02 V, 34→0.72 V, 38→0.18 V at comparable C). Capacitance shows a hard voltage ceiling (C=80→1.10 V, 150→1.015 V, 500→0.563 V); because the minimum allowed C=80µF already gives the highest voltage and larger C lowers it, the cap cannot be used to boost voltage. The main piezo peak never exceeds ~1.46 V, and a passive diode rectifier cannot turn <1.5 V AC into ≥2.0 V DC. The stored-supply voltage (~1.1 V) is below the 1.8 V brownout and the 2.0 V minimum gate, so every run showed faults=4, delivered_on_time=0, brownouts=0, and all pipeline stages 0. Aux/RC envelope only feeds the 2nF detector (cannot charge storage) and is nuisance-driven at its strongest tuning; threshold is moot without boot. Mechanical margins are enormous (stress/travel slack ≈0.9), and beam width/thickness/tip-mass are fixed, so no remaining degree of freedom adds the roughly 4× energy (2× voltage) needed. The unknown stationary length-factor can only detune the 33mm optimum, never reach 1.8 V. Hence no design in the declared domain meets the spec: global infeasibility. Residual ~18% uncertainty only reflects possible untested aux-mechanical-coupling effects, which cannot raise a separate rectified DC source above its ~1.1 V ceiling.

diagnosis.label: INFEASIBLE
diagnosis.reason: The storage capacitor can never reach the minimum 2.0 V boot voltage. Across the whole legal domain the main harvesting beam's peak output rises monotonically with length (0.38 V @24mm → 0.50 @28 → 1.14 @34 → 1.20 @42) and never resonates — its resonance is beyond the 42 mm cap. The rectified storage ceiling tracks main_peak minus diode drop, reaching only 0.845 V at the globally most favorable corner (main=42mm max, C=80µF min, gate=2.0V min). That is ~2.4x short in voltage (~5.6x in energy) of the 2.0 V gate, the lowest allowed, so BOOT/TX never occur (confirmed: 0 boots, 0 deliveries, 0 brownouts — cap never charges). All energy knobs are already at their favorable extremes, so no untested combination helps; threshold_V governs wake only and is irrelevant. The aux beam's sharp resonance at its nominal 18mm indicates the effective-length factor is ~unity, so it cannot shift the main beam's resonance into the reachable window. The energy-storage architecture cannot satisfy the supply requirement.
